decisions.question: Openai Astra publically available before September 7th 2026
decisions.thinking: OpenAI only initiated its formal U.S. government pre-release cybersecurity review on September 1 after Astra met the 'Critical' preparedness threshold. A full public release within 5 days is virtually impossible given mandatory government review timelines and standard phased rollout procedures.
decisions.uncertainty: Whether OpenAI rushes a limited public preview before September 7 despite the ongoing government pre-release cybersecurity review.
decisions.resolution_risk: Without a description, the creator might resolve YES on a restricted developer beta or partner-only release if they consider it 'publicly available'.
evidence_for: OpenAI announced on September 1, 2026, that Astra is entering its final pre-launch phase and will be available 'soon'.
OpenAI occasionally does fast turnarounds on announced models or surprise public drops/previews.
evidence_against: On September 1, 2026, OpenAI disclosed Astra met the 'Critical' cybersecurity threshold under its Preparedness Framework, triggering a formal U.S. government pre-release review.
A formal government cybersecurity pre-release review and required hardware security rollout cannot plausibly complete in the ~4 days before September 7, 2026.
OpenAI flagship and high-risk capability models follow phased rollouts (safety reviews, partner access, red teaming) before general public availability.
